source_meaning_criteria: Every original case criterion remains unchanged. Preserve names, actors/roles, numbers/units/relationships, actions, negation, uncertainty, chronology and conditions. Fluency/lexical checks are not semantic approval. Any material meaning error rejects promotion.
stop_rules: Stop on first execution, structure, protocol, output cap, missing final answer, nonempty reasoning, cleanup, time or sampled resource failure. Preserve complete/partial outputs.
Semantic flags do not trigger tuning; independent reviewer grades every completed original case.
No retries, heldout reads/runs, summary calls or production integration in this stage.
